name: comete_sc_t2_stir
author: EMPENN
description: Segmentation of spinal cord lesions based on a pair of T2Sag and STIR MRIs. The pipeline takes a T2Sag image and a set of STIR MRIs (the specific STIR corresponding to the T2Sag is not known in advance) and produces a binary lesion segmentation mask, a lesion probability map, and a YAML report describing the volume and location of detected lesions, along with QC elements. If the pipeline fails, an error YAML file describing the transmitted inputs and the cause of failure is produced instead.source: https://gitlab.inria.fr/ms-pipelines/scientific_code/spinal_cord/inference/crosssectional_multi_modalities/-/tree/comete_t2_stir?ref_type=heads
command-line: unzip [INPUT_T2] -d T2DIR; unzip [INPUT_STIR] -d STIRDIR; mkdir OUTDIR ; python3 /app_primus/inference_multimodal.py -t T2DIR -s STIRDIR -o OUTDIR && cp input_params.json OUTDIR && tar -cvzf [OUTPUT_FILE] OUTDIR && chmod -R 777 *

inputs.name: T2 archive
inputs.description: NIfTI ZIP archive of a T2Sag spinal cord MRI.

inputs.name: STIR archive
inputs.description: NIfTI ZIP archive of a set of STIR MRIs potentially corresponding to the provided T2Sag image.

output-files.description: Tarball containing, on success: binarized.nii.gz (binary spinal cord lesion segmentation, obtained by applying specific PRIMUS parameters to pmap.nii.gz), pmap.nii.gz (lesion probability map resulting from model predictions), results.yaml (pipeline information, lesion volumes and bounding boxes), and qc.pdf (raw T2/STIR, extracted T2/STIR, and spinal cord segmentation overlay; may be absent). On failure: error.yaml (describes the transmitted inputs and explains what went wrong) and QC elements.
output-files.name: Output archive
